story|title:noveltygate novelty not erro.title: NoveltyGate: Novelty, Not Error, Decides Which VLA Prefix Tokens to Compute Exactly

story|title:orthogonally mixed sign codi.title: Orthogonally Mixed Sign Coding with Progressive Residual Refinement for Transformer Weight Compression

story|title:self upgrading embodied agen.summary_1line: A 27B language-model embodied agent in a household environment edits one tensor of its own weights overnight, tested against its unchanged self, and the kept edit improves task completion and step efficiency.
